answers.question: How has it done against its benchmark and category over 3, 5 and 10 years?

sentences.text: Over the last 3 years the fund returned 8.6% a year, above its benchmark (CRISIL Short Duration Debt Index) at 8.1% and above the Short Duration Fund average of 7.9%.
Over the last 5 years the fund returned 8.5% a year, above its benchmark (CRISIL Short Duration Debt Index) at 7.8% and above the Short Duration Fund average of 7.6%.
Over the last 10 years the fund returned 8.3% a year, above its benchmark (CRISIL Short Duration Debt Index) at 7.7% and above the Short Duration Fund average of 7.5%.
